the source world Province JSON Merger

Upload or paste JSON under any province. The helper scans the entire JSON for known the source world settlement names and automatically moves each settlement record into the correct canonical province and settlement slot before export.

Canonical matching is built in from the attached the source world province/settlement JSON. Matching ignores accents, curly/straight apostrophes, punctuation, spacing, capitalization, file suffixes, and province suffixes. Example: Lun’tharavé, Luntharave, and lun tharave are treated as the same label. If a pasted file is placed under the wrong province but contains a known settlement name, the export still places that settlement under the right province.

DM Map export target: click the export button and choose C:\Users\thetr\OneDrive\Documents\site\DM\tools\Dm Map Editor. The file is saved as dm_map.json. Browsers require you to approve the folder picker; if folder saving is blocked, the tool falls back to a normal dm_map.json download.
